title: 183. High-Functioning Depression & Trauma in College Students feat. Judith Joseph, M.D., M.B.A.
description_html: Today's guest is Judith Joseph, M.D., M.B.A.— a board-certified psychiatrist and researcher, Chair of Women in Medicine at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons, Clinical Assistant Professor at NYU Langone Medical Center, and founder of the first research lab to study high-functioning mental health conditions. She posts social media content for over 1 million followers and recently received a Congressional Proclamation from the U.S. House of Representatives for her social media advocacy and research.
talk_about: + Why high-functioning mental health disorders can be overlooked
